subject: Phase 100378: Full CLI Configuration, Ranking, and Sync Surface
verdict_justification: Phase 100378 cleanly implements the full CLI configuration, ranking, and sync surface (clio config get/set/profiles/use, clio ranking get/set, and clio sync status/push/pull/serve) through existing shared runtime and MCP dispatchers, preserving exact tool semantics and fail-closed security guarantees. Masking is verified across all config views, weight normalization and dry-run work as specified, single-host sync correctly explains the FR-31 omission, all files strictly adhere to <=450 lines and AGENTS.md headers, and all 311 reported files satisfy >=90% line and function coverage floors. Three minor findings were identified regarding single-host sync argument validation, patch-file error messaging, and an unnecessary 1-second sleep in unit tests.

findings.title: `sync status` skips positional and flag validation on single-host deployments
findings.evidence: crates/clio-lib/src/sync_cli.rs:108-114 (`if sub == "status" && single_host { return emit_single_host(io, mode); }`). Live verification: `./target/debug/clio sync status unexpected_arg` exits 0 on single-host, but exits 2 with `unexpected extra argument` on multi-host (`sync.omit=false`). Likewise, `./target/debug/clio sync status --banks ""` exits 0 on single-host but exits 2 on multi-host.
findings.remediation: RESOLVED (r1). In `crates/clio-lib/src/sync_cli.rs` the pure flag-decode `build(&verb, &parsed, io.env)` now runs BEFORE the single-host short-circuit, so `no_positionals` and `--banks` validation apply in both deployment modes. Regression test added: `single_host_status_rejects_bad_args_like_multi_host` (crates/clio-lib/src/sync_cli_tests.rs). Before: `./target/debug/clio sync status unexpected_arg` -> exit 0 with the single-host explanation. After: `error: unexpected extra argument \`unexpected_arg\`` exit 2; `sync status --banks ""` -> `error: --banks must name at least one bank` exit 2; `sync status` and `sync status --banks demo` still exit 0 with the explanation on single-host.
findings.recommendation: In `crates/clio-lib/src/sync_cli.rs`, run `crate::runtime_cli::no_positionals(&parsed)?` and validate argument flags prior to short-circuiting for `single_host`, ensuring consistent exit-code 2 usage errors across deployment modes.

findings.title: `ranking set` error message references `--patch` when `--patch-file` contains invalid JSON
findings.evidence: crates/clio-lib/src/ranking_cli.rs:103-105 (`serde_json::from_str(&raw).map_err(|error| CliError::usage(format!("--patch must be a JSON object: {error}")))?; if !patch.is_object() { return Err(CliError::usage("--patch must be a JSON object")); }`). Live verification: `./target/debug/clio ranking set --patch-file=/tmp/invalid.json` outputs `error: --patch must be a JSON object`.
findings.remediation: RESOLVED (r1). In `crates/clio-lib/src/ranking_cli.rs::set_call` the error now dynamically names the flag that supplied the patch (`--patch` when inline, `--patch-file` when file-based). Before: `ranking set --patch-file=/tmp/invalid.json` -> `--patch must be a JSON object: ...`. After: `ranking set --patch-file=/tmp/invalid.json` -> `error: --patch-file must be a JSON object: expected value at line 1 column 17` exit 2; inline `--patch 'not-json'` still says `--patch must be a JSON object: ...` (existing test at ranking_cli_tests.rs:116 unchanged and passing). New assertion added to `ranking_set_reads_a_patch_file` requiring `--patch-file must be a JSON object` for an invalid patch file.
findings.recommendation: In `crates/clio-lib/src/ranking_cli.rs`, dynamically mention `--patch-file` or use `"--patch or --patch-file must provide a JSON object"` in the error messages.

findings.title: Unit test `render_dispatches_and_covers_transfer_and_serve_banks` incurs an unconditional 1-second sleep
findings.remediation: RESOLVED (r1). `wait_for_ttl` in `crates/clio-lib/src/sync_cli.rs` now takes a `std::time::Duration` instead of whole seconds; production passes `Duration::from_secs(ttl)` unchanged in behavior. The test at `sync_cli_tests.rs` uses `wait_for_ttl(Duration::from_millis(1))` (sleep branch still covered) and `wait_for_ttl(Duration::ZERO)` elsewhere. Measured: `cargo test -p clio --bin clio render_dispatches` took 1.00s before, 0.00s after; full bin suite `cargo test -p clio --bin clio` passes 532/532 in 2.10s.
findings.recommendation: Avoid real 1-second sleeps in unit test suites. Parameterize `wait_for_ttl` or test sleep duration with millisecond resolution / injectable sleep mock so unit test suites remain fast.

remediation_note.summary: All three findings fixed by the Remediator directly (F-01 and F-03 share sync_cli.rs, so the slices were coupled; no worker fan-out). Scoped test pass 532/532 bin tests; final gates: `make check` exit 0, `make coverage` exit 0 with 311 files meeting the 90% floors (TOTAL lines 97.99% / functions 98.82%). Per-file re-read for touched production files: sync_cli.rs 99.39% lines / 93.55% functions, ranking_cli.rs 98.85% lines / 90.91% functions. Changed Rust file sizes: sync_cli.rs 441, sync_cli_tests.rs 329, ranking_cli.rs 144, ranking_cli_tests.rs 185 lines (all <=450). plan_unlimited items left unchanged: they are future-phase design considerations, not defects; no requirement currently demands them.
